text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is Falco, signing off! ☆ Thanks for
watching
my performance! ♪

text_block_list.name: Falco Fans
text_block_list.text:
Falcooo!
That was great!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks again for coming! I hope to see
you all
again next time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is doing well in her races.
As a
result, she's steadily gaining
popularity, and more
and more people
are coming to watch her street

performances.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm so lucky to have so many people
cheer for me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's only one way to repay everyone,
and
that's to become a top Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's going to be more races I can
enter this
year, so I wanna see my fans
from up onstage lots
more.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Our next goal...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon has been improving
steadily. I'm
sure she can hold her own in
the major
classic-year races.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So, um, about that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It turns out that Smart Falcon has a
proposition of
her own—one that
catches me off guard.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I wanna run in the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho—the first race of the
Classic
Triple Crown. It's a big deal,
but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I know I'm always a disaster when
it comes
to turf races...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But still, I wanna give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The determination in her eyes reminds
me of
when we first met, back when she
insisted turf was
the only way. I thought
she had moved on...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, not at all! That's not it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've already decided that I'm gonna run
on dirt.
But, well...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember what that one fan
said?

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But don't you want to hear someone with
her kind
of energy sing "Winning the
Soul"?

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know what you mean. Imagine
how hype it
would be seeing her up on
stage at the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There are only three opportunities to
sing
"Winning the Soul"—the three big
turf races of
the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I don't go for it now, there'll never be
another
chance to sing that song for
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can't let that happen. I wanna be an
Umadol
who meets everybody's
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Until just recently, I could count the
number of
fans I had on one hand.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But now, suddenly, there are so many
people
cheering for me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
They all have such high hopes for me,
and I want
to live up to them...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a long time, Falco did her best
despite having
only a tiny following.
That's why she treasures her
fans more
than anyone else does. However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only is she ill-suited for turf, the
competition
vying for the Triple Crown is
top class. Frankly,
I'm worried if she can
even put up a fight.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I know. I know I've never been much
good on
turf.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still! An Umadol never backs down
without even
trying!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If there's even one person who believes
in me and
wants to hear me sing...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As long as there's a chance of winning,
no matter
how small, I wanna go for it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll always chase after any opportunity to
shine!
'Cause that's the kind of Umadol I
believe in!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So... Trainer! Please let me run in the
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's chosen an incredibly difficult road
to
walk—for her fans and for her beliefs.
As her
trainer, there's really only one
thing I can say.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Then does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Swayed by Smart Falcon's
determination, I've
made my choice. Our
next race is one of the
Classics—the
Satsuki Sho!
